sources.role: collinear kernel and explicitly chosen homogeneous Collins approximation

equation: d h(x,Q2)/d ln(Q2) = alpha_s(Q2)/(2*pi) integral_x^1 dz/z P(z) h(x/z,Q2)
mellin_convention: h_N = integral_0^1 dx x^(N-1) h(x); P_N = CF*(3/2-2*H_N)

quantities.transversity: unweighted spacelike h1(x), no gluon mixing at LO
quantities.KPSY_Hhat3_homogeneous: unweighted Hhat^(3)(z) as defined in KPSY Eq.56; Eq.71 keeps only the homogeneous term with the same kernel
quantities.rejected: x*h1, generic Collins, or Trento H1perp first moment without an explicit conversion contract

coupling.asymptotic_two_loop: explicit AsymptoticTwoLoopCoupling constructor; Lambda and nf determine alpha_s(Q02); see KPSY-CSS-001
coupling.model_identity: the asymptotic 1/L expansion and an exact two-loop RG solution are distinct definitions; never silently substitute one for the other

discretization.convolution: analytic integration on each cell after plus subtraction
discretization.time_solution: exp(tau*P) with the exact integral of the explicitly selected coupling definition

derivatives.validated_coordinates: initial ordinates with the last ordinate fixed to zero
derivatives.operator_settings: fixed grid, coupling definition, alpha0 or Lambda, scales, nf, quantity and scheme; fitted settings require a separately validated dU term

validation_policy.scope: analytic polynomial inputs, independent x-space/Mellin routes; not production G2 or interval coverage
validation_policy.grid_allocation: one quarter of intervals logarithmic from xmin to 0.02; remainder uniform in sqrt(1-x) to x=1

remaining_for_KPSY: historical coupling/backend and original grid/settings comparison
full CSS assembly and matching coefficients
